svg.title: ESP32-S3, OLED, RTC, RS485, Acrel ADL400, buttons and optional buzzer wiring
svg.desc: Midea Fort schematic. Labels and colors identify connections. Screen values are simulated.
svg.text: GPIO17 to DI, GPIO18 from RO, GPIO16 to tied DE and /RE. All low-voltage grounds share one net.
OLED and RTC share the SDA and SCL nets.
17 / 18 are pulse outputs. Do not connect them as RS485.
Q1 + 1 kΩ + 10 kΩ are additional parts.
Find physical B/C/E pin order in the transistor datasheet.
Repeated GND/3V3 labels identify one net. Dots mark joins. Crossings without dots do not connect. Port positions are not physical headers.
